title: Your shuffle has probably never happened before
body: A deck has 52! orders, about 8 x 10^67, more than atoms in many stars' worth of comparisons. A thorough shuffle therefore plausibly produces an arrangement that has never existed in history. Casinos do not rely on that poetry; riffle studies show seven good shuffles are needed to truly randomise.
source_hint: Bayer and Diaconis, riffle shuffle analysis (1992)
